bias.en: Rebound · SAR flipped bullish, capped at $246–247.5
bias.zh: 反弹 · 抛物线 SAR 转多，受制于 $246–247.5

read.en: Teradyne fell 0.2% on Nov 10 to $245.40, trading $237.57–254.23. It is above the 5-day ($234.7) and below the 10-day ($258.8), 30-day ($333.4), 100-day ($363.7) and 200-day ($350.0); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR flipped bullish on Nov 10 ($211.63), and RSI is 34.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 11月10日下跌 0.2%，收于 $245.40，盘中区间 $237.57–254.23。股价位于 5 日（$234.7）均线上方，10 日（$258.8）、30 日（$333.4）、100 日（$363.7）和 200 日（$350.0）均线下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 于 11月10日转为看多（$211.63），RSI 为 34。

read.en: No level changed: the $254.23 high pierced the $245.9–247.5 resistance but the close slipped back under it, and the $237.57 low held above the 5-day ($234.7). Resistance is $245.9–247.5, then $254.2–258.8 (Nov 10 high, Nov 2 low, 10-day) and $266.4. Support is $234.7–242.1, then $227 and $211.6–212.6 (SAR, Nov 5–6 lows). A close above $247.5 would target $254–259; below $234.7, $227.
